text:
QUOTE: "Schema stale, index newer, or code stale: restart the MCP client. A rebuild does not help in either case." and "Data stale: ... call `index(action='refresh')`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the data axis is cleared by a rebuild/refresh while the code axis (and schema when the index is newer) requires a client restart, because a rebuild cannot fix them. It never says this is why one flag would not have been enough, but the substance, that the axes need different remedies, is there.
